title: AUDIO row still never persisted though effect_settings_adjust routes it through settings_save_app
evidence: case rnd.SETTINGS_ROW_AUDIO: au.toggle_mute(&app.audio) } settings_save_app(app)  —  A11y_Settings :: struct { palette: rnd.Palette_Mode, reduced_motion: bool, scale_step: u8 } (no mute byte)
detail: Mute resets on relaunch; the new settings_adjust_audio_effect test asserts only au.is_muted, never a persist. Not fixed by this 4-file delta.
recommended_fix: Persist the mute byte (bump SETTINGS_VERSION) or correct the effect comment and panel copy.

title: S still cannot close the settings panel while a pipe is selected — footer copy 'S / tap chip to close' false in that state
evidence: case .S: if inp.sel_pipe < 0 { if keys_n < len(keys) { keys[keys_n] = .S; keys_n += 1 } }  vs  draw_text_c(v, "S / tap chip to close", ...)
detail: Keyboard close is dead with a pipe selected (S keeps its Standard-lane meaning); chip tap and pad B still close.
recommended_fix: Collect S whenever panel_open regardless of sel_pipe (the panel is modal), or fix the copy.

title: QoS panel proportion bar still draws raw constants (QOS_PANEL_X+118, y+7, h=8, QOS_PANEL_W-150) inside the hud()-scaled panel
evidence: bw := i32((QOS_PANEL_W - 150) * u64(caps[lane]) / max(1, total)); if bw > 0 { rl.DrawRectangle(QOS_PANEL_X + 118, y + 7, bw, 8, cols[lane]) }
detail: Legibility drift at x1.25/x1.50 (the r3-fix family): the bar renders off-grid inside the scaled panel.
recommended_fix: Route the bar geometry through rnd.hud()/hud_f() like the rest of the panel.

title: In-progress drag still survives a settings-panel open/close — a release after close commits the stale draw
evidence: case Toggle_Settings: inp.panel_open = !inp.panel_open; if inp.panel_open { inp.panel_row = 0; inp.press_swallowed = true } (no drag cancel)  vs  if inp.panel_open { // suppressed — the panel owns the surface } else if drag_eff && placing_eff < 0 {
detail: S is collectible mid-drag (sel_pipe<0); the modal suppresses releases while open but preserves the armed drag across the cycle.
recommended_fix: Cancel/clear inp.drag when the panel opens (or on close) so no stale gesture commits late.

title: Settings_Navigate row-wrap boundaries (Up from row 0, Down from row 3) still untested at exec level
evidence: r := inp.panel_row + v.delta; if r < 0 { r += n }; if r >= n { r -= n } — grep of app/*_test.odin and harness/parity.odin finds no Settings_Navigate leg
detail: Wrap arithmetic is a one-line-off class; only the pure scale/palette cycles are pinned. Not added by this delta.
recommended_fix: Add an exec-level nav-wrap assert (row 0 Up -> row 3; row 3 Down -> row 0).

title: demolish_button_rect keeps the unscaled nil-view fallback; parity still calls that branch
evidence: demolish_button_rect :: proc(pop: rl.Rectangle, v: ^View = nil) -> rl.Rectangle { if v != nil { ... hud_f ... } return {pop.x + 10, pop.y + pop.height - 36, pop.width - 20, 26} }
detail: Latent second geometry the app never draws; parity:998 passes no view. Unchanged by this delta.
recommended_fix: Require the view (drop the default nil) or have parity pass one.

title: sla_row_rect leaves x=8/width=740 unscaled in the otherwise hud()-scaled pass
detail: Hit-width/anchor do not scale with the knob (cosmetic at x1.25+).
recommended_fix: hud() the x and width too, or document the deliberate raw values.

title: Settings header comment still says 'Version 1: 4 bytes' vs the actual 6-byte layout
evidence: // Format: a tiny versioned binary (ODN-11's ... Version 1: 4 bytes — magic, version, then three u8 values ... + a checksum byte.

title: step_of still has no production caller — only settings_test references it
evidence: grep -rn "step_of" app/*.odin | grep -v test -> only the definition + comment
detail: Dead helper retained through the r7 delta.
recommended_fix: Use it in the panel display path or remove it.

title: tmp_settings_path doc comment still attached to the wrong proc (rnd_palette_for_test)
evidence: // tmp_settings_path — a unique temp path PER CALL ... rnd_palette_for_test :: proc() -> rnd.Palette { return rnd.palette_load() }  followed by tmp_settings_path :: proc(t: ^testing.T)
detail: Comment drifted off its proc by the inserted helper.

title: Phase-1 key buffer still [10]Key vs 11 collectible keys — a same-frame super-chord silently drops the last
evidence: keys: [10]Key — collectible: P/Space, D, T, M, S, Up, Down, Left, Right, Enter = 11
detail: Guarded appends drop keys beyond 10; unreachable in normal play.
recommended_fix: Size the buffer to the collectible set (11).

title: Closed-panel branch still emits Settings_Navigate for Up/Down and collects Left/Right/Enter it never maps
evidence: case .Up, .Down, .Left, .Right, .Enter: if keys_n < len(keys) { ... } collected unconditionally; the closed-panel switch maps only Up/Down (no-ops when closed)
detail: Harmless (executor gates on panel_open) but latent confusion.
recommended_fix: Collect nav keys only when panel_open, or drop the closed Up/Down mapping.

title: Active-mode chip text never reflects reduced-motion-only activation
evidence: case: return "A11Y: 125%+" if v.ui_scale > 1.001 else "A11Y SETTINGS (S)" — reduced_motion alone falls through to the default
detail: draw_settings_chip's `active` styling keys on reduced_motion but the text does not.

title: parse_mode_table still sets roofs_set before validating elements — a malformed entry yields BLACK roofs
evidence: t.roofs_set = true; for i in 0..<4 { if q, okq := arr[i].(json.Array); okq { t.roofs[i] = jcol_arr(q, {0, 0, 0, 255}) } }
detail: A non-array element keeps a zero (black) roof with roofs_set=true; palcheck-visible, not a crash.
recommended_fix: Count valid elements; set roofs_set only if all 4 parsed.
